gate: OQ1: PostToolUse payload / transcript offset stability

environment.method: isolated scratchpad mini-repo with project-level .claude/settings.json PostToolUse/Stop dump hooks + headless `claude -p --model haiku` child sessions; live-transcript sha256 prefix checks on the supervising session; structural analysis of historical transcripts for /clear and compact

hook_stdin_shape.detail: stdin is a single JSON object per event. PostToolUse top-level keys: cwd, duration_ms, hook_event_name, permission_mode, prompt_id, session_id, tool_input, tool_name, tool_response, tool_use_id, transcript_path. Stop top-level keys: background_tasks, cwd, hook_event_name, last_assistant_message, permission_mode, prompt_id, session_crons, session_id, stop_hook_active, transcript_path.
hook_stdin_shape.evidence: 3 PostToolUse payloads (Read/Edit/Bash) + 2 Stop payloads captured; shape identical across tools

tool_name_field.detail: top-level `tool_name` field, values observed: Read / Edit / Bash. Full tool_input and tool_response objects included.
tool_name_field.evidence: e.g. Read: tool_input={file_path}, tool_response={type:'text', file:{filePath, content, numLines, startLine, totalLines}}

transcript_path_source.detail: top-level `transcript_path` (absolute path to session .jsonl under ~/.claude/projects/<sanitized-cwd>/<session_id>.jsonl) present in both PostToolUse and Stop payloads; session_id also top-level.
transcript_path_source.evidence: path resolved to probe repo's sanitized project dir and matched actual file on disk

offset_byte_stability.detail: transcript .jsonl is append-only. sha256 of the byte prefix unchanged across subsequent Read/Write/Edit/Bash tool calls (2 rounds on live supervising session: prefix 631770B then 670409B), and unchanged across a `claude -p --resume` continuation of the probe session (90643B -> 110237B, prefix sha stable, same file — resume does NOT create a new jsonl).
offset_byte_stability.evidence: sha256 prefix comparisons; scratchpad oq1-baseline.txt / oq1-round2.txt

stop_sentinel_offset_reread.detail: Stop payload carries transcript_path; a byte offset recorded at Stop remains valid for later re-reads because the file is append-only and resume continues the same file. Stop also carries last_assistant_message and stop_hook_active (loop guard).
stop_sentinel_offset_reread.evidence: resume test above; Stop payloads captured in probe

criteria.three_tools_read_edit_bash: PASS — all three captured with identical payload shape
criteria.clear_offset_reproducible: PASS (structural evidence) — historical /clear instance sits at line 10 of a 938-line jsonl: /clear logs a command entry and the SAME file keeps appending; no rewrite. All timestamp backsteps in that file <= 3s (parallel-write jitter only).
criteria.compact_offset_reproducible: PASS (structural evidence) — historical auto-compact instance at line 585/2306: compact appends a system entry subtype=compact_boundary (with compactMetadata) + a user entry isCompactSummary=true to the SAME file; pre-compact entries remain in place; file keeps appending after.

deviations: /clear and compact were validated via structural analysis of historical transcripts (this project + recycling-recognition-tender) rather than actively triggered in the probe session — headless -p cannot issue /clear, and forcing an auto-compact is costly. Combined with the direct append-only byte proofs, the evidence chain is judged sufficient.

timestamp monotonicity is NOT a valid write-order signal and must not be used by the worker: attachment entries carry creation-time (observed up to 62min behind), isMeta entries carry backfilled times, parallel tool writes jitter <= 3s. Byte offset is the only reliable cursor.
design_implications_for_m2a: tool_name is available top-level — no transcript parsing needed to route on tool type
transcript_path + session_id available in every PostToolUse and Stop payload — hook can persist {transcript_path, byte_offset} as spool cursor without any guessing
byte offset cursor is safe across tool calls, /clear, auto-compact, and --resume (same file, append-only)
worker must tolerate compact_boundary/isCompactSummary/isMeta/attachment entry types when parsing the window
do not order or dedupe by timestamp; use file order (byte offset) only
stop_hook_active flag available for Stop-hook loop protection
raw_evidence_note: full payload dumps kept in session scratchpad (oq1-hookprobe/hook-dump.jsonl); representative shapes inlined above
